members.name: items
members.doc: The rows or cards as data: strings, or items with an `id`, a `label`, a `textValue`, and `disabled`. Children take precedence: when both are supplied, the items are not rendered.

members.name: selectedIds
members.doc: The selected item ids when the caller controls the selection, or `'all'`.

members.name: defaultSelectedIds
members.doc: The ids selected at first when the list controls its own selection, or `'all'`.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables every item and stops the selection and action callbacks. An item's own `disabled={false}` cannot re-enable it under a disabled list.

members.name: selectionMode
members.doc: How many items can be selected. With `onAction` set and `single` or `multiple`, a click or Enter runs the action while nothing is selected and Space starts a selection; once an item is selected, a click changes the selection instead.

members.name: onSelectionChange
members.doc: Called with the selected item ids, or `'all'`, when the selection changes. It is not called while the list is disabled.

members.name: onAction
members.doc: Called when the user activates an item. A list built from `items` passes the item record; one built from children passes the identity fields `id`, `key`, and `value`. It is not called for a disabled item or while the list is disabled.

members.name: layout
members.doc: `stack` is a vertical list of rows. `grid` lays the items out in auto-fill columns of at least 10rem, as cards whose content wraps. Inside a grid Virtualizer a GridList must use `grid`.

members.name: orientation
members.doc: The direction a stack layout runs. `horizontal` scrolls along the inline axis and moves between items by their rendered positions. Inside a grid Virtualizer a GridList must be `vertical`.

members.name: id
members.doc: The stable string id the selection and action callbacks report.

members.name: textValue
members.doc: The text typeahead matches and the item's name. Without one it is the text of the item's children, which is unambiguous only for plain text, so give rich children a `textValue`.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the item. A disabled list disables every item whatever this says.

types.name: MuxUICollectionItem

members.name: value
members.doc: Consumer data; named Select and ComboBox forms submit the item `id`, not `value`.

types.name: MuxUIAriaAccessibleName
